newsitem.title: USA: BPA plans to lift Intertie rate midnight on Monday.
newsitem.headline: BPA plans to lift Intertie rate midnight on Monday.

text.p: Usage of the Pacific Intertie power transmission system will likely be increased to 7,200 megawatts (MW) around midnight on Monday, a spokesman for the Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) said Friday.

The Western Systems Coordinating Council approved late Friday raising the Intertie capacity from a current maximum of 6,250 MW, but some concerns remain about operating procedures, said BPA's Perry Gruber.
"We will probably be working those out on Monday," he noted.
BPA operates the Pacific Northwest segment of the interstate transmission system, which links the region to Southern California.
